notes: Deploy only src/ConditionalsFacts.sol:ConditionalsFacts on Robinhood Chain. It provides perpetual TRUE/FALSE LMSR markets in IMD, settled through IdentityMD oracle challenges. Constructor arguments are owner, IMD, Intake v2, oracle signer and fee recipient, in declaration order. Ownership is assigned to $owner. The owner can add oracle configurations for future rounds after a 3-day delay, with a 7-day activation window, and set the fee recipient.
